note: The gate run. No new scientific defect surfaced; the constraints below are operational.

constraints.title: The permanent checker now carries I12, so REPRODUCE.md's whole-document equality check is stale for fresh reproductions
constraints.statement: check_world gained I12 permanently. Re-running any older registration still reproduces every registered number (B5 records zero I12 violations; baseline preserved totals are the I1-I11 sums), but result documents gain two baseline fields (i12Violations, totalViolationsNote), so the v1.0.0 REPRODUCE.md one-liner comparing whole documents no longer holds against a fresh reproduction.
constraints.remediation: Documented in REPRODUCE-v1.3.0.md's version-compatibility note and in HANDOFF known-stale items. Field-level comparisons in the versioned REPRODUCE documents are the operative checks. The registered v1.0.0 document itself is not edited.
